name: Unidentified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle (Count Dooku's frigate)/Legends
description: A Sheathipede-class transport shuttle was stolen from Count Dooku's frigate by Jedi Generals Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi during a skirmish of the Clone Wars. Skywalker and Kenobi used it to pursue Count Dooku to Vanqor, where both parties crash-landed.
